Priya (eng-ml): quick follow-up from the kv-eviction postmortem. i'd like to propose a compact 'needlepack' of tests we can ship fast: a 60-prompt regression pack, a prefix-length sweep load test, and a 15m chaos microdrill. comments?
Marco (eng-platform): love the needlepack name :) i'll wire a `pre-merge/goldens` job and a `nightly/prefix-sweep` in CI. can we pick two golden prompts that always run in PRs?
June (sre): i'll take the microdrill and runbook. scope: simulate eviction pressure + pod restart for 15 minutes, record eviction heatmap, and verify rollback criteria. ETA for first dry-run: 12 days.
Sam (eng-oncall): ops asks for concrete owners + dates so we can track. staging canary target = 14 days. full rollout after 5 weeks with dashboarding.
Priya (eng-ml): i'll own the needlepack curation. plan: start from incident repro prompts, add category buckets (long-prefix reuse, short-burst, mixed), tag 2 goldens `@golden-pair`. ETA: 8 days for initial pack.
Marco (eng-platform): sample pre-merge smoke snippet i'll use: `pytest tests/regressions/test_goldens.py -k golden` (fast, <30s). will push metrics to eval-db. ETA for CI jobs + dashboard: 10 days.
June (sre): small ask: include a signal in the runbook that distinguishes cache-pressure-only vs memory-OOM. that will help reduce noisy rollbacks.
Priya (eng-ml): good call. i'll include a small scorer that emits semantic-drift + token-delta metrics so we can threshold sensibly.
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-2633 "needlepack-kv-eviction-mitigation". Subtasks: EPI-2633-1 needlepack prompts (Priya) due 1778670000, EPI-2633-2 ci jobs + dashboards (Marco) due 1778750000, EPI-2633-3 chaos microdrill + runbook (June) due 1778753600.
Sam (eng-oncall): summary: owners assigned, epic created, staging canary in 14 days, reconvene in 6 days for status. i'll add a recurring monthly check "kv-needlepack review" to oncall duties.
Priya (eng-ml): ack, starting curation now.
Marco (eng-platform): ack, creating branch `ci/kv-needlepack` and will link PR here.
June (sre): ack  will schedule the dry-run and invite owners.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: status check in 6 days (1778007600).
